purpose: tip dump clearance deployed vs stowed and pressure check
code_or_query:
import math
# masses and geometry
m_robot_no_soil=47.0 # kg incl structure per E41
m_soil_trip=15.0
m_hopper_steel=4.5
g=9.81
# chassis: stowed 0.9x0.45x0.45, deployed track widens
wheel_d=0.20; grouser=0.01; wheel_R=wheel_d/2+grouser
wheel_w=0.12
wheelbase=0.62 # m axle to axle deployed
track_stowed=0.42; track_deployed=0.68
length_stowed=0.90; length_deployed=1.05 # ladder forward adds length
# ground pressure 4 wheels
contact_L=0.0632
area=4*(contact_L*wheel_w)
pressure=(m_robot_no_soil+m_soil_trip)*g/area/1000 # kPa
# tip about rear axle during rear dump: stabilizing = (robot w/o hopper load) * forward CG distance; overturning = (hopper+soil at tilt) * rear overhang
# assume robot CG 0.30m forward of rear axle, hopper pivot 0.10m behind rear axle, soil CG 0.25m behind rear axle at full tilt, pivot height 0.55m
F_stab=(m_robot_no_soil- (m_hopper_steel+m_soil_trip))*g*0.30 # only chassis forward? conservative: full robot minus raised load forward
F_over=(m_hopper_steel+m_soil_trip)*g*0.25
SF=F_stab/F_over
# dump lip clearance: pivot height 0.55m, bin lip 0.40m assumed Lunabotics bin wall, need outlet above lip + trajectory over lip
pivot_h=0.55; lip_h=0.40; clearance=pivot_h-lip_h
print(f"area {area:.4f} m2 pressure {pressure:.1f} kPa")
print(f"stab {F_stab:.0f} Nm over {F_over:.0f} Nm SF {SF:.2f}")
print(f"pivot {pivot_h} lip {lip_h} clearance {clearance:.2f} m")
print(f"stowed {length_stowed}x{track_stowed} deployed len {length_deployed} track {track_deployed} wheelR {wheel_R:.3f}")
print(f"wheel clearance to frame: track growth {(track_deployed-track_stowed)/2:.3f} m side shift, rotation gap 0.025 m specified")
